data.text: Not claimed, nothing edited. The fix cannot fit the item's globs: a request needs a row in ddflow/services/approvals/sites.py (Canon refuses an uninventoried verb; MARKER_CALLS pins new refusal sites), and sw-remoteauth holds that file on P-remote.auth (at rubber_duck, 7 gates to go). Proposed plan, for the operator or coordinator to confirm: one new T2 verb lane.approve over target lane-template:NAME or lane-plugin:HARNESS, state = the current digest, rendered text shows the template fields or the plugin diff from the record. A person answers through approvals ask and attest; the requesting agent carries it with --approval ID, chore_approve pattern, so approval.grant records the person with a proxy stamp. Direct terminal path for a person with a --digest read receipt. Must hold: the verb stays out of policy RULES and RETRY_VERBS, pinned by a test with every rule on and auto_approve_after_retries=1, so no standing rule can approve a template. Also needed: PS.PROVIDERS gets no repo or cfg, so approvals_request must resolve the digest differently for this verb. lanehooks.py line ~155 carries the same dead-end advice. Put the command under the approvals group: surfaces/exemptions.py then needs no edit, and DX-fleet-registry holds surfaces/declared/lanes.py.
